## Products

Amphenol is one of the world’s largest designers, manufacturers and marketers of connectors and
interconnect systems, antennas solutions, sensors and high-speed cable. Our connector and connector
system solutions include fiber optic interconnect, harsh environment interconnect, high-speed
interconnect, power interconnect, power distribution and busbars and radio frequency (RF)
interconnect products. Our sensors and sensor-based product solutions include gas and moisture
sensors, level sensors, position sensor, pressure sensors, temperature sensors and vibration
sensors. Our value-added cable assemblies include cable assemblies and harnesses, cable management
products and backplane interconnect systems. Our cable solutions include coaxial cable, power cable
and specialty cable. We also provide combiner/splitter products, flexible and rigid printed circuit
boards, hinges and molded parts.

# Amphenol PCD is the world's leading manufacturer of interconnect products for Military & Aerospace
# harsh environment applications.

[
View All Products
][80] [
Drawings & Models
][81] [
Solutions Guide
][82]

Amphenol PCD designs and manufactures** circular and rectangular electronic connectors** for low,
medium and high power applications and** lightweight composite cable and pipe management solutions**
for wire, hydraulic and fuel systems for the military and aerospace industries. We take pride in our
ability to create **customizable cable assemblies** and **advanced In-Seat Portable Electronic
Devices (PED)**, offering a range of power and audio solutions such as Bluetooth, high-power USBs,
audio jacks, and wireless charging. From standard to fully customized cable solutions, Amphenol PCD
provides reliable, **high performance cable assemblies** tailored to meet demanding application
requirements.

Supporting Amphenol divisions globally, Amphenol PCD offers **rugged network solutions** including
Media Converters, Ethernet Switches and high speed Ethernet Connectors,  **Backshells** and **Dust
Cap connector accessories** that provide strain relief, environmental protection, and EMI/RFI
shielding at the termination area of virtually any connector, easily mated and unmated magnetic
**soldier worn solutions** and a variety of special applications connectors and custom interconnect
systems.  Amphenol PCD delivers the innovative, high-quality solutions you need to power and protect
your systems.

## FEATURING

### [SPIN TACT™][83]

SPIN TACT™ delivers advanced slip rings and fiber optic rotary joints (FORJs) engineered for
continuous power, RF, and high-speed optical data transmission across rotating interfaces. Designed
for defense, aerospace, naval, industrial, and medical platforms, SPIN TACT™ solutions provide
proven performance in harsh, high-shock, high-vibration environments.

### [Nano Pegasus][84]

Nano Pegasus are small, composite, easy to use connectors designed specifically for sensing, command
and control applications where a Micro or Nano Dsub would be used. Ideal for use in tight spaces,
packing 11 high grade contacts in a shell size 5 housing.

### [OmniLite ][85]

OmniLite Backshells can be configured to a straight, 45°, or 90° position, aiding in SKU reduction
initiatives. The high-performance thermoplastic backshells provide strain relief and EMI/RFI
shielding at the termination area for MIL-DTL-38999 Series III connectors.

Amphenol PCD designs and manufactures** circular and rectangular electronic connectors** for low,
medium and high power applications and** lightweight composite cable and pipe management solutions**
for wire, hydraulic and fuel systems for the military and aerospace industries. We take pride in our
ability to create **customizable cable assemblies** and **advanced In-Seat Portable Electronic
Devices (PED)**, offering a range of power and audio solutions such as Bluetooth, high-power USBs,
audio jacks, and wireless charging. From standard to fully customized cable solutions, Amphenol PCD
provides reliable, **high performance cable assemblies** tailored to meet demanding application
requirements.

Supporting Amphenol divisions globally, Amphenol PCD offers **rugged network solutions** including
Media Converters, Ethernet Switches and high speed Ethernet Connectors,  **Backshells** and **Dust
Cap connector accessories** that provide strain relief, environmental protection, and EMI/RFI
shielding at the termination area of virtually any connector, easily mated and unmated magnetic
**soldier worn solutions** and a variety of special applications connectors and custom interconnect
systems.  Amphenol PCD delivers the innovative, high-quality solutions you need to power and protect
your systems.

## FEATURING

### [SPIN TACT™][83]

SPIN TACT™ delivers advanced slip rings and fiber optic rotary joints (FORJs) engineered for
continuous power, RF, and high-speed optical data transmission across rotating interfaces. Designed
for defense, aerospace, naval, industrial, and medical platforms, SPIN TACT™ solutions provide
proven performance in harsh, high-shock, high-vibration environments.

### [Nano Pegasus][84]

Nano Pegasus are small, composite, easy to use connectors designed specifically for sensing, command
and control applications where a Micro or Nano Dsub would be used. Ideal for use in tight spaces,
packing 11 high grade contacts in a shell size 5 housing.

### [OmniLite ][85]

OmniLite Backshells can be configured to a straight, 45°, or 90° position, aiding in SKU reduction
initiatives. The high-performance thermoplastic backshells provide strain relief and EMI/RFI
shielding at the termination area for MIL-DTL-38999 Series III connectors.

### [HPAC][86]

HPAC features an innovative and easy-to-use locking system offering a perfect connection security, a
lever mating mechanism and a CPA (Connector Position Assurance). This quick-mate and quick-install
connector facilitates operator’s work for both installation and maintenance and is suited for high
demanding power applications.

From the laboratory to the production line, Anton Paar delivers precise, reliable instruments that

Anton Paar has a long history of providing high-end laboratory instruments: density meters,
refractometers, polarimeters, instruments for sample preparation and synthesis, viscometers,

## Anton Paar USA Inc. - Company Overview Information

The Anton Paar Group develops, produces, distributes and provides support for analytical instruments
used in research, development and quality control worldwide. Located in Ashland, Virginia, Anton
Paar USA provides sales, application support and service to users throughout North America and the
Islands.

Anton Paar produces high-end measuring and laboratory instruments for industry and research. It is
the world leader in the measurement of density, concentration and CO2 and in the field of rheometry.
Other areas of specialty are: Petroleum testing, microwave synthesis, viscometry, polarimetry,
refractometry, X-ray scattering, sample preparation and surface characterization.

The core competence of Anton Paar – high-precision production – and close contact to the scientific
community, form the basis for the quality of Anton Paar’s instruments. Continuous training and
investments in R&D ensure that Anton Paar products live up to their excellent reputation.

## Trusted Measurement Solutions for Research and Industry

From the laboratory to the production line, Anton Paar delivers precise, reliable instruments that
help you achieve confident results every time.

[Discover our solutions][68]

## From Lab to Line – Explore Our Complete Product Range

** Laboratory Instrumentation**
Anton Paar has a long history of providing high-end laboratory instruments: density meters,
refractometers, polarimeters, instruments for sample preparation and synthesis, viscometers,
rheometers, and instruments for material characterization.
[Explore laboratory solutions][69]
**Process Instrumentation**
Anton Paar has your solution for inline production monitoring: The portfolio covers density and
concentration sensors, inline refractometers, process viscometers, flow meters, and sensors for
measuring dissolved CO₂.
[Explore process solutions][70]
**Automation and Robotics**
Anton Paar designs automation solutions from the first idea to final production: sample changers for
automating single devices, robotically operated rheometers and a platform which automates multiple
instruments.
[Explore automation solutions][71]

## Great people. Great instruments.

Progress, innovation, and uncompromising precision define Anton Paar. Our measuring instruments
combine precisely manufactured components, advanced measuring principles, and intuitive user
interfaces to deliver reliable performance in demanding laboratory and production environments.
Developed in close collaboration with our customers, our solutions meet specific application needs,
simplify workflows, and solve complex measurement challenges. As a global leader in density and
concentration measurement, rheometry, material characterization, and dissolved CO₂ determination,
Anton Paar continues to push the limits of what is technically possible.

## Latest insights & innovations

**Autosorb 3300 Flow Chemisorption Analyzer**
The Autosorb 3300 chemisorption analyzer delivers fully automated characterization of catalysts,
enabling essential measurements to be performed reliably and quickly.
[Learn more][73]
**New Dispersion Units for Litesizer DIA/DIF**
Switch between dispersion units with the Quick-Click feature in just one move – no need for any
extra cables, tubes, or pipes.
[Learn more][74]
**Meet our latest Modular Compact Rheometers**
MCR 303/503/503 Power are based on new modular platform architecture, enabling outstanding
measurement quality to ensure excellent reproducibility.
[Learn more][75]
**Introducing the new handheld Cora 101**
One of the lightest handheld Raman spectrometers on the market, Cora 101, enables clear and fast
identification of unknown substances in the field or in the lab.
[Learn more][76]

## Anton Paar USA Inc. - Company Overview Information

The Anton Paar Group develops, produces, distributes and provides support for analytical instruments
used in research, development and quality control worldwide. Located in Ashland, Virginia, Anton
Paar USA provides sales, application support and service to users throughout North America and the
Islands.

Anton Paar produces high-end measuring and laboratory instruments for industry and research. It is
the world leader in the measurement of density, concentration and CO2 and in the field of rheometry.
Other areas of specialty are: Petroleum testing, microwave synthesis, viscometry, polarimetry,
refractometry, X-ray scattering, sample preparation and surface characterization.

The core competence of Anton Paar – high-precision production – and close contact to the scientific
community, form the basis for the quality of Anton Paar’s instruments. Continuous training and
investments in R&D ensure that Anton Paar products live up to their excellent reputation.

### What is Claude and how does it work?

Claude is an artificial intelligence, trained by Anthropic using Constitutional AI to be safe,
accurate, and secure — the trusted assistant for you to do your best work.

You can use Claude for your own personal use or create a Team account to collaborate with your
teammates. [Learn more about Claude][60].

### What should I use Claude for?

If you can dream it, Claude can help you do it. Claude can process large amounts of information,
brainstorm ideas, generate text and code, help you understand subjects, coach you through difficult
situations, simplify your busywork so you can focus on what matters most, and so much more.

limited use with no payment required. [Learn more about available pricing plans][61].

## FAQ

### What is Claude and how does it work?

Claude is an artificial intelligence, trained by Anthropic using Constitutional AI to be safe,
accurate, and secure — the trusted assistant for you to do your best work.

You can use Claude for your own personal use or create a Team account to collaborate with your
teammates. [Learn more about Claude][60].

### What should I use Claude for?

If you can dream it, Claude can help you do it. Claude can process large amounts of information,
brainstorm ideas, generate text and code, help you understand subjects, coach you through difficult
situations, simplify your busywork so you can focus on what matters most, and so much more.

### How much does it cost to use?

Claude has five pricing plans available — Free, Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise. The Free plan offers
limited use with no payment required. [Learn more about available pricing plans][61].

## JST INNOVATION IS ALL AROUND YOU

JST connectors can be found in a wide variety of products across many industries. Select a category
below to explore how they are used.

### Industries
1. Automotive
2. Amusement Equipment
3. A / V Equipment
4. Business Equipment
5. Information & Communication Equipment
6. Traffic Systems & Heavy Electronics
7. Home Appliances
8. Industrial Equipment

[Close up image of cars parked in a parking lot]

### Automotive

From airbags and headlights to ignition coils and data control modules, JST connectors can be found
in almost every part of every automotive. These are just some of the connectors used in the
industry:
* **Headlight:** CPT
* **Inverter: **CPT, CPI, MEC
* **Switch on instrument panel assembly: **HCM, AIT2
* **Ignition coil:** NFG
* **Antilock brake system****:** ASG
* **Battery pack:** SPH2
* **Airbag****:** HIC, SNA, SAB, SQS, SQH, SQM, SQF

[Close up image of a lit-up slot machine]

### Amusement Equipment

Originating in Japan, the pachinko machine is a staple in many arcades and casinos. Check out how
JST connectors power the fun:
* **Liquid Crystal Display unit:** SHL, FHY, FHH, FCH
* **Main control board/payout board:** ZE, PA, PUD, PND, PNI, XA, JQ, UB, DSH
* **CR unit:** ZE, PA, Dsub
* **Speaker unit:** PS, Tab-on terminal
* **Surface board (connection part of main chassis frame):** PUD, JFA, RTZ, TSF
* **Power supply unit:** PUD, XH, VH, VL, JFA, Ring tongue terminal

[A speaker in front of a lit-up screen]

### A / V Equipment

From image sensors and lens boards in digital cameras to backlight inverters and controller boards
in TVs, JST connectors play a vital role in a variety of Audio-Visual equipment. The following are
just some of our elements that can be found in a Liquid Crystal television:
* **Liquid Crystal Television**
* **Power supply board:** PA, VH, NV, VYH, VA, VT
* **Backlight invertor board:** BD, BDE
* **Controller board:** GVH, GH, GHD, ZE, PNI, SCV
* **Liquid crystal driver board:** SHLV, SHL, SHLD, GH

[Someone placing a piece of paper and pressing a button on a copy machine]

### Business Equipment

When it comes to modern business technology, any piece of office equipment could contain JST
connectors. For example, a multifunction machine, such as a printer/copier, may include:
* **Connection of external unit:** DAC, OTZ
* **Controller board:** DIM, DM, JMF, RHM
* **Connection of unit (drawer):** RFC, RIJ, RIC, RIZ, RWZ, RWM, RVE
* **Main board:** CS family/CZ family series
* **Power supply board:** VH, PSI, NV, VL, VYH, VA, NVA, VSL, HL, XL

[Close up image of hands typing on a laptop]

### Information & Communication Equipment

Having cutting-edge information and communication equipment is vital in today’s world. That’s why
companies rely on JST parts to power devices such as laptops and smartphones, which may include:

[The following is for a smartphone:]
* **Slot for SIM card:** SCUL, SCYT, SCZT
* **Slot for micro SD card:** SDHL, SDHR, SDHK, SDH
* **Headphone jack:** EP
* **Interface for micro USB:** UB
* **Connector for FPC to board:** JAK, JAT

[Overhead view of a train on elevated tracks]

### Traffic Systems & Heavy Electronics

JST connectors are used in traffic systems and heavy electronics, such as railway vehicles and the
equipment used to run transport stations. For example, the following parts may be found in an
automatic turnstile:
* **IC card control board:** SR
* **Power supply board:** VH, JFA
* **Controller board:** ZR, PH, PHD, PA, PNI, XA, XAD, UB

[Three kitchen appliances sitting next to vegetables on a kitchen towel]

### Home Appliances

The innovative parts we engineer and manufacture are used extensively throughout the home appliance
industry. The controller boards in the following appliances are often made with JST connectors:
* **Hot water heater:** XA, VH, PA, XA, XH, PS, Solderless terminal
* **Washing machine:** VH, XL
* **Refrigerator:** VH, ZPD, XNI, XA
* **Air conditioner:** GH, PA, XA, PH, GH

[A view from behind of someone wearing a hardhat and holding a digital tablet standing in front of a
piece of machinery]

### Industrial Equipment

Servo amplifiers are used in industrial equipment to transmit electrical signals and control
movement. The following JST connectors can be found in servo amplifiers:
* **PC communication:** UB (Mini USB)
* **Input Output Signal:** MS
* **Safety circuit:** CIF
* **Battery connection:** PA
* **Motor encoder:** XV
* **Connection between boards:** JYR
* **Power supply system:** JFA (J-FAT-S-H)

## JST INNOVATION IS ALL AROUND YOU

JST connectors can be found in a wide variety of products across many industries. Select a category
below to explore how they are used.

### Industries
1. Automotive
2. Amusement Equipment
3. A / V Equipment
4. Business Equipment
5. Information & Communication Equipment
6. Traffic Systems & Heavy Electronics
7. Home Appliances
8. Industrial Equipment

[Close up image of cars parked in a parking lot]

### Automotive

From airbags and headlights to ignition coils and data control modules, JST connectors can be found
in almost every part of every automotive. These are just some of the connectors used in the
industry:
* **Headlight:** CPT
* **Inverter: **CPT, CPI, MEC
* **Switch on instrument panel assembly: **HCM, AIT2
* **Ignition coil:** NFG
* **Antilock brake system****:** ASG
* **Battery pack:** SPH2
* **Airbag****:** HIC, SNA, SAB, SQS, SQH, SQM, SQF

[Close up image of a lit-up slot machine]

### Amusement Equipment

Originating in Japan, the pachinko machine is a staple in many arcades and casinos. Check out how
JST connectors power the fun:
* **Liquid Crystal Display unit:** SHL, FHY, FHH, FCH
* **Main control board/payout board:** ZE, PA, PUD, PND, PNI, XA, JQ, UB, DSH
* **CR unit:** ZE, PA, Dsub
* **Speaker unit:** PS, Tab-on terminal
* **Surface board (connection part of main chassis frame):** PUD, JFA, RTZ, TSF
* **Power supply unit:** PUD, XH, VH, VL, JFA, Ring tongue terminal

[A speaker in front of a lit-up screen]

### A / V Equipment

From image sensors and lens boards in digital cameras to backlight inverters and controller boards
in TVs, JST connectors play a vital role in a variety of Audio-Visual equipment. The following are
just some of our elements that can be found in a Liquid Crystal television:
* **Liquid Crystal Television**
* **Power supply board:** PA, VH, NV, VYH, VA, VT
* **Backlight invertor board:** BD, BDE
* **Controller board:** GVH, GH, GHD, ZE, PNI, SCV
* **Liquid crystal driver board:** SHLV, SHL, SHLD, GH

[Someone placing a piece of paper and pressing a button on a copy machine]

### Business Equipment

When it comes to modern business technology, any piece of office equipment could contain JST
connectors. For example, a multifunction machine, such as a printer/copier, may include:
* **Connection of external unit:** DAC, OTZ
* **Controller board:** DIM, DM, JMF, RHM
* **Connection of unit (drawer):** RFC, RIJ, RIC, RIZ, RWZ, RWM, RVE
* **Main board:** CS family/CZ family series
* **Power supply board:** VH, PSI, NV, VL, VYH, VA, NVA, VSL, HL, XL

[Close up image of hands typing on a laptop]

### Information & Communication Equipment

Having cutting-edge information and communication equipment is vital in today’s world. That’s why
companies rely on JST parts to power devices such as laptops and smartphones, which may include:

[The following is for a smartphone:]
* **Slot for SIM card:** SCUL, SCYT, SCZT
* **Slot for micro SD card:** SDHL, SDHR, SDHK, SDH
* **Headphone jack:** EP
* **Interface for micro USB:** UB
* **Connector for FPC to board:** JAK, JAT

[Overhead view of a train on elevated tracks]

### Traffic Systems & Heavy Electronics

JST connectors are used in traffic systems and heavy electronics, such as railway vehicles and the
equipment used to run transport stations. For example, the following parts may be found in an
automatic turnstile:
* **IC card control board:** SR
* **Power supply board:** VH, JFA
* **Controller board:** ZR, PH, PHD, PA, PNI, XA, XAD, UB

[Three kitchen appliances sitting next to vegetables on a kitchen towel]

### Home Appliances

The innovative parts we engineer and manufacture are used extensively throughout the home appliance
industry. The controller boards in the following appliances are often made with JST connectors:
* **Hot water heater:** XA, VH, PA, XA, XH, PS, Solderless terminal
* **Washing machine:** VH, XL
* **Refrigerator:** VH, ZPD, XNI, XA
* **Air conditioner:** GH, PA, XA, PH, GH

[A view from behind of someone wearing a hardhat and holding a digital tablet standing in front of a
piece of machinery]

### Industrial Equipment

Servo amplifiers are used in industrial equipment to transmit electrical signals and control
movement. The following JST connectors can be found in servo amplifiers:
* **PC communication:** UB (Mini USB)
* **Input Output Signal:** MS
* **Safety circuit:** CIF
* **Battery connection:** PA
* **Motor encoder:** XV
* **Connection between boards:** JYR
* **Power supply system:** JFA (J-FAT-S-H)

Our team of in-house engineers are experts on the industries we serve and the products we sell. We

We’re committed to helping our customers create excellent products. No project is too ambitious or
difficult for us and we take the time to find you the most suitable products for your needs, at the
right price.

### Unbiased, independent advice

We’re privately owned and operated, so we’re not tied to any brand. We can give you unbiased, honest
advice so you can achieve the best outcome for your project.

We give you access to the products and stock you need, when you need them. With **next-day UK
delivery**, we can help you get the products you need quickly.

We support our customers with the latest technologies, helping them benefit from the newest
innovations from the leading brands. If there’s a new product on the horizon, or an emerging
technology you want to facilitate, we’re here to help.

# Company Profile

Dynalink Electronic Technology Co., Ltd (DL), established in 2007, currently has a workforce of over
800 employees, among which more than 200 are technical staff. It is a technology-driven design and
manufacturing company specializing in power supplies, energy storage capacitors, and connectors.

With continuous investment in research and development and strong innovation capabilities, the
company has built a complete industrial chain encompassing material research and development,
product design, and precision manufacturing. Thanks to the advantages of high reliability and
excellent performance, its products are widely used in key fields such as aviation, aerospace,
shipping, railways, new energy vehicles, the medical industry, drones, and robots, providing
customized solutions for customers.

The company strictly complies with international standards and has been certified by the following
globally recognized management systems:

## Why Choose Dynalink Electronic?

DL not only provides customers with high-quality power supplies, energy storage capacitors, and
connectors, as well as full-cycle services, but also, relying on its profound technical accumulation
and innovative capabilities, has established a comprehensive customized development system.

🚁

### Field of Drones

In the field of drones, our products ensure efficient battery charging and discharging and the
stable operation of the power system, enabling extended flight endurance and mission reliability.

🖥️

### For Data Centers

For data centers, high-speed connectors and stable power supplies ensure low-loss transmission of
massive amounts of data and the reliable operation of equipment at scale.

⚙️

### Industrial Application

In industrial automation scenarios, connectors with high protection performance and precision power
supplies provide solid support for equipment operating in complex environments.

⚡

### Requirement Response

Relying on our self-developed intelligent design platform, we can quickly respond to customer needs
and provide integrated solutions from components to systems, significantly reducing time-to-market.

🔬

### Technological Innovation

In the future, DL will continue to deeply engage in technological innovation, promote industrial

# ept Connectors - Precision Electronics!

Welcome to our website. As a **leading manufacturer in connector technology**, we invite you to
explore our comprehensive expertise. As an independent family-owned company with over **50 years of
experience,** we guarantee **technical expertise and the highest quality standards, combined with
creativity and precision**, for your specific product or machine solution. Our expertise—drawn in
part from the automotive sector—ensures that our products and solutions meet the highest quality
standards. **We understand the importance of reliable and efficient connections in an ever-evolving
industry.**
  At our locations in Peiting, Buching, Augsburg, the Czech Republic, the U.S., and China, as well
as through our international sales network, nearly 1,200 employees worldwide deliver first-class
work in development, production, and service. We are certified to **ISO 9001:2015**, **IATF
16949:2016, ISO 14001:2015**, and **ISO 50001:2018**.
Let’s shape the future together.

# ept Connectors - Precision Electronics!

Welcome to our website. As a **leading manufacturer in connector technology**, we invite you to
explore our comprehensive expertise. As an independent family-owned company with over **50 years of
experience,** we guarantee **technical expertise and the highest quality standards, combined with
creativity and precision**, for your specific product or machine solution. Our expertise—drawn in
part from the automotive sector—ensures that our products and solutions meet the highest quality
standards. **We understand the importance of reliable and efficient connections in an ever-evolving
industry.**
  At our locations in Peiting, Buching, Augsburg, the Czech Republic, the U.S., and China, as well
as through our international sales network, nearly 1,200 employees worldwide deliver first-class
work in development, production, and service. We are certified to **ISO 9001:2015**, **IATF
16949:2016, ISO 14001:2015**, and **ISO 50001:2018**.
Let’s shape the future together.

[Technician Repairing Garage Door]

#### Garage Door Repair

Garage doors can break at any time of day. That’s why at Precision Garage Door of Colorado, we have
someone waiting to answer your call 24/7 and schedule your appointment at a time that is convenient
for you. Our trucks always carry a full inventory of parts, which means we are prepared to repair
your garage door in a single visit.

We repair and replace many commonly broken garage door parts, including springs, openers, cables,
rollers, panels, and more. If you don’t know what your problem is, don’t worry. Our expertly trained
technicians will quickly diagnose the problem and explain it to you clearly before starting any
work. Give us a call today and learn more about our [same day garage door repair offers][131].

[New Garage Doors & Installation]

#### New Garage Doors & Installation

We have a large selection of garage doors including Steel Garage Doors & Carriage House Doors. We
provide **free estimates** on all new garage doors and offer outstanding warranties. To get an idea
of what your door could look like, try our [garage door designer online now][132].

Whether you're looking for the carriage house style to add some curb appeal, an insulated door that
reduces energy bills, or just a completely reliable door that's also affordable, we've got the
perfect door for your home. Learn more about our garage door offers [here][133].

[Technician Installing Opener]

#### Garage Door Openers

Precision Garage Door of Colorado offers a wide variety of new garage door openers to choose from,
including LiftMaster® openers. We install garage door openers that you can rely on and back them up
with an excellent warranty. You can read more about the various features on our [garage door openers
page][134].

##### We Can Even Repair Your Current Opener

Often, your garage door opener does not need to be replaced; instead, it can be [repaired for a
fraction of the cost][135]. Our technicians always arrive with a fully stocked truck, so they will
carry the parts needed to repair your garage door opener. If you’re not sure whether you need a
repair or replacement, give us a call and we’ll send a technician your way.

[Technician Repairing Garage Door]

#### Garage Door Repair

Garage doors can break at any time of day. That’s why at Precision Garage Door of Colorado, we have
someone waiting to answer your call 24/7 and schedule your appointment at a time that is convenient
for you. Our trucks always carry a full inventory of parts, which means we are prepared to repair
your garage door in a single visit.

We repair and replace many commonly broken garage door parts, including springs, openers, cables,
rollers, panels, and more. If you don’t know what your problem is, don’t worry. Our expertly trained
technicians will quickly diagnose the problem and explain it to you clearly before starting any
work. Give us a call today and learn more about our [same day garage door repair offers][131].

[New Garage Doors & Installation]

#### New Garage Doors & Installation

We have a large selection of garage doors including Steel Garage Doors & Carriage House Doors. We
provide **free estimates** on all new garage doors and offer outstanding warranties. To get an idea
of what your door could look like, try our [garage door designer online now][132].

Whether you're looking for the carriage house style to add some curb appeal, an insulated door that
reduces energy bills, or just a completely reliable door that's also affordable, we've got the
perfect door for your home. Learn more about our garage door offers [here][133].

[Technician Installing Opener]

#### Garage Door Openers

Precision Garage Door of Colorado offers a wide variety of new garage door openers to choose from,
including LiftMaster® openers. We install garage door openers that you can rely on and back them up
with an excellent warranty. You can read more about the various features on our [garage door openers
page][134].

##### We Can Even Repair Your Current Opener

Often, your garage door opener does not need to be replaced; instead, it can be [repaired for a
fraction of the cost][135]. Our technicians always arrive with a fully stocked truck, so they will
carry the parts needed to repair your garage door opener. If you’re not sure whether you need a
repair or replacement, give us a call and we’ll send a technician your way.

*About us*
*Xiamen GHGM Industrial Trade Co., Ltd.*
GHGM，A high-tech enterprise focusing on the research and development, production and sales of
high-quality terminal blocks and connection systems, its main products include quick-connect
terminals, LED connectors, PCB terminal blocks, floating board-to-board connectors, high-density
board-to-board connectors, simple connectors, waterproof connectors, industrial connectors, wiring
harnesses, switch cabinet connectors and wiring harness cables, switch cabinet insulation
accessories, switch cabinet injection molding parts and other products. The related products have
obtained hundreds of domestic and foreign patent authorizations, and have passed product quality
certifications such as UL in the United States, VDE, TUV, CE, CQC, REACH, RoHS in Germany, etc., and
have always been in a leading position in China in terms of technology, with customers all over the
world.   GHGM，With two factories located in Xiamen, Fujian and Dongguan, Guangdong, we adopt the
international standard quality management system and introduce domestically advanced fully automatic
stamping and injection molding machines, mold processing equipment, automatic packaging systems,
automated assembly lines and other production equipment. Our manufacturing processes and technical
equipment are far ahead. We are the first in the industry to pass IATF16949, ISO9001, ISO14001 and
other certifications, and we specialize in providing customers with connection system solutions for
lighting, industrial electrical and new energy vehicles.

# Reliable connector system solutions

# Who we are

When reliable transmission of data, signals, and power is critical, ODU is your partner for
high-performance connectors and connectivity solutions.

Our systems are used worldwide in medical technology, military and security technology, test and
measurement, industrial applications, robotics, and the automotive industry – even in **demanding
environments and harsh operating conditions**.

From circular connectors and modular connectors to electrical contacts and fully assembled,
customized system solutions, ODU provides everything from a single source. With **80 % in-house
manufacturing depth**, we ensure highest quality standards, short development cycles and solutions
tailored to your application.

# Reliable connector system solutions

# Who we are

When reliable transmission of data, signals, and power is critical, ODU is your partner for
high-performance connectors and connectivity solutions.

Our systems are used worldwide in medical technology, military and security technology, test and
measurement, industrial applications, robotics, and the automotive industry – even in **demanding
environments and harsh operating conditions**.

From circular connectors and modular connectors to electrical contacts and fully assembled,
customized system solutions, ODU provides everything from a single source. With **80 % in-house
manufacturing depth**, we ensure highest quality standards, short development cycles and solutions
tailored to your application.

### Cable Management

Keep your systems protected, organized, and performing with a wide range of cable management

At Plastron precision, we pride ourselves on our collaborative approach to connector manufacturing. 
With a commitment to innovation, we work closely with our customers from the concept stage, ensuring
a seamless development process. Our expertise extends beyond product design, encompassing a holistic
partnership that transforms ideas into high-quality connectors. 

###### Product Design

Through Advanced Design: We stand out as a premier connector manufacturer with a focus on
cutting-edge product design. Our commitment to excellence includes harnessing the power of Mold Flow
and FEA (Finite Element Analysis) capabilities. By integrating these advanced tools into our design
process, we ensure precision, efficiency, and reliability in every connector we create.

###### Tooling

Our commitment to excellence extends to our in-house tooling center, equipped with cutting-edge
technology from globally renowned brands such as Yamada and FANUC. With dedicated expertise in
tooling development, we ensure meticulous design and production, setting the highest standards for
quality and precision in every connector.

###### Rapid Prototyping

We prioritize agility and innovation in connector manufacturing. Our Rapid Prototyping capabilities
allow us to swiftly transform ideas into tangible prototypes.

###### Manufacturing

As a leading connector manufacturer, we take pride in our state-of-the-art Automation Department,
dedicated to designing and developing assembly automation machines.
Currently boasting 120 sets of automated machinery for various products, we ensure efficiency and
precision in our production processes. Additionally, our in-house electroplating facility guarantees
end-to-end control over plating quality.

#### Garage Door Repair

Garage doors can break at any time of day. That’s why at Precision Garage Door of Colorado Springs,
we have someone waiting to answer your call 24/7. We will schedule your appointment at a time that
is convenient for you. Our trucks always carry a full inventory of parts, which means we are
prepared to repair your garage door in a single visit, and we're located nearby, so we'll be there
quickly. Unlike some of our competitors, we **don't** charge you an extra fee for same day service.

We repair and replace many commonly broken garage door parts, including: springs, openers, cables,
rollers, panels, and more. If you don’t know what your problem is, don’t worry. Our expertly trained
technicians will quickly diagnose the problem and explain it to you clearly before starting any
work. Give us a call today and learn more about our [No Service Fee Offer][110].

[Technician Repairing Garage Door]

#### New Overhead Garage Doors & Installation

We have a large selection of garage doors including Steel Garage Doors, Carriage House Doors and
Custom Wood Garage Doors. We provide **free estimates** on all new garage doors and offer
outstanding warranties. To get an idea of what your door could look like, try our [garage door
designer online now][111].

Whether you're looking for the beautiful "Carriage House" style that adds beauty and old world style
to your home, an energy efficient door that reduces energy bills, or just want a completely reliable
garage door that's also affordable, we've got a model that fits your needs. Lean more about our
garage door offers [here][112].

[New Amarr Garage Door Installed]

#### Garage Door Openers

Precision Garage Door of Colorado Springs offers a wide variety of new garage door openers to choose
from, including LiftMaster® openers. We offer garage door opener models that you can rely on, and
back it up with an excellent warranty. You can read more about the various features on our [garage
door openers page][113].

##### We Can Even Repair Your Current Opener

Often, your garage door opener does not need to be replaced; instead, it can be [repaired for a
fraction of the cost][114]. Our technicians always arrive with a fully stocked truck, so they will
carry the parts needed to repair your garage door opener. If you’re not sure whether you need a
repair or replacement, give us a call and we’ll send a technician your way.

[Technician Installing Garage Door Opener]

#### Garage Door Repair

Garage doors can break at any time of day. That’s why at Precision Garage Door of Colorado Springs,
we have someone waiting to answer your call 24/7. We will schedule your appointment at a time that
is convenient for you. Our trucks always carry a full inventory of parts, which means we are
prepared to repair your garage door in a single visit, and we're located nearby, so we'll be there
quickly. Unlike some of our competitors, we **don't** charge you an extra fee for same day service.

We repair and replace many commonly broken garage door parts, including: springs, openers, cables,
rollers, panels, and more. If you don’t know what your problem is, don’t worry. Our expertly trained
technicians will quickly diagnose the problem and explain it to you clearly before starting any
work. Give us a call today and learn more about our [No Service Fee Offer][110].

[Technician Repairing Garage Door]

#### New Overhead Garage Doors & Installation

We have a large selection of garage doors including Steel Garage Doors, Carriage House Doors and
Custom Wood Garage Doors. We provide **free estimates** on all new garage doors and offer
outstanding warranties. To get an idea of what your door could look like, try our [garage door
designer online now][111].

Whether you're looking for the beautiful "Carriage House" style that adds beauty and old world style
to your home, an energy efficient door that reduces energy bills, or just want a completely reliable
garage door that's also affordable, we've got a model that fits your needs. Lean more about our
garage door offers [here][112].

[New Amarr Garage Door Installed]

#### Garage Door Openers

Precision Garage Door of Colorado Springs offers a wide variety of new garage door openers to choose
from, including LiftMaster® openers. We offer garage door opener models that you can rely on, and
back it up with an excellent warranty. You can read more about the various features on our [garage
door openers page][113].

##### We Can Even Repair Your Current Opener

Often, your garage door opener does not need to be replaced; instead, it can be [repaired for a
fraction of the cost][114]. Our technicians always arrive with a fully stocked truck, so they will
carry the parts needed to repair your garage door opener. If you’re not sure whether you need a
repair or replacement, give us a call and we’ll send a technician your way.

[Technician Installing Garage Door Opener]

#### Garage Door Repair

Garage doors can break at any time of day. That’s why at Precision Garage Door of Kansas City, we
have someone waiting to answer your call 24/7. We will schedule your appointment at a time that is
convenient for you. Our trucks always carry a full inventory of parts, which means we are prepared
to repair your garage door in a single visit.

We repair and replace many commonly broken garage door parts, including: springs, openers, cables,
rollers, panels, and more. If you don’t know what your problem is, don’t worry. Our expertly trained
technicians will quickly diagnose the problem and explain it to you clearly before starting any
work. Give us a call today and learn more about our [same day garage door repair offers][188].

[Technician Repairing Garage Door]

#### New Garage Doors & Installation

We have a large selection of garage doors including Steel Garage Doors, Carriage House Doors and
Custom Wood Garage Doors. We provide **free estimates** on all new garage doors and offer
outstanding warranties. To get an idea of what your door could look like, try our [garage door
designer online now][189].

Whether you're looking for the beautiful "Carriage House" style that adds beauty and old world style
to your home, an energy efficient door that reduces energy bills, or just want a completely reliable
garage door that's also affordable, we've got a model that fits your needs. Learn more about our
garage door offers [here][190].

[New Amarr Door Installed]

#### Garage Door Openers

Precision Garage Door of Kansas City offers a wide variety of new garage door openers to choose
from, including LiftMaster® openers. We offer garage door opener models that you can rely on, and
back it up with an excellent warranty. You can read more about the various features on our [garage
door openers page][191].

##### We Can Even Repair Your Current Opener

Often, your garage door opener does not need to be replaced; instead, it can be [repaired for a
fraction of the cost][192]. Our technicians always arrive with a fully stocked truck, so they will
carry the parts needed to repair your garage door opener. If you’re not sure whether you need a
repair or replacement, give us a call and we’ll send a technician your way.

#### Garage Door Repair

Garage doors can break at any time of day. That’s why at Precision Garage Door of Kansas City, we
have someone waiting to answer your call 24/7. We will schedule your appointment at a time that is
convenient for you. Our trucks always carry a full inventory of parts, which means we are prepared
to repair your garage door in a single visit.

We repair and replace many commonly broken garage door parts, including: springs, openers, cables,
rollers, panels, and more. If you don’t know what your problem is, don’t worry. Our expertly trained
technicians will quickly diagnose the problem and explain it to you clearly before starting any
work. Give us a call today and learn more about our [same day garage door repair offers][188].

[Technician Repairing Garage Door]

#### New Garage Doors & Installation

We have a large selection of garage doors including Steel Garage Doors, Carriage House Doors and
Custom Wood Garage Doors. We provide **free estimates** on all new garage doors and offer
outstanding warranties. To get an idea of what your door could look like, try our [garage door
designer online now][189].

Whether you're looking for the beautiful "Carriage House" style that adds beauty and old world style
to your home, an energy efficient door that reduces energy bills, or just want a completely reliable
garage door that's also affordable, we've got a model that fits your needs. Learn more about our
garage door offers [here][190].

[New Amarr Door Installed]

#### Garage Door Openers

Precision Garage Door of Kansas City offers a wide variety of new garage door openers to choose
from, including LiftMaster® openers. We offer garage door opener models that you can rely on, and
back it up with an excellent warranty. You can read more about the various features on our [garage
door openers page][191].

##### We Can Even Repair Your Current Opener

Often, your garage door opener does not need to be replaced; instead, it can be [repaired for a
fraction of the cost][192]. Our technicians always arrive with a fully stocked truck, so they will
carry the parts needed to repair your garage door opener. If you’re not sure whether you need a
repair or replacement, give us a call and we’ll send a technician your way.

## Global Precision Wellness

Global Precision Wellness (GPW) stands at the forefront of the shift from reactive healthcare to a
proactive, data-driven model. Based in Malaysia, this organization focuses on bridging the gap
between advanced clinical science and everyday lifestyle habits. By moving away from
“one-size-fits-all” advice, GPW empowers individuals and organizations to optimize their health
based on their unique biological blueprints, including genetic profiles and specific blood markers.

The core of GPW’s philosophy is rooted in **Nutrigenomics** and personalized diagnostics. Rather
than relying on trial-and-error dieting, their approach uses non-invasive DNA testing to analyze how
an individual’s specific genes interact with nutrition, metabolism, and environmental factors. This
genetic clarity allows for the creation of tailored nutritional strategies that help clients manage
weight, boost energy levels, and proactively reduce the risk of chronic, lifestyle-related
conditions.

Beyond individual assessments, GPW is deeply integrated into the corporate landscape. Recognizing
that human capital is an organization’s most valuable resource, they provide **HRDC-claimable
training programs** designed to reduce burnout and improve workplace morale. These programs, led by
certified consultant dietitians, educate employees on how to interpret their own medical data,
manage stress through nutrition, and implement sustainable lifestyle changes. By bringing “Wellness
Day” blood screenings directly to the office, GPW helps teams catch potential health imbalances
before they escalate into significant medical issues.

The organization’s “Health Transformation Programs” represent the application of these data-driven
insights. These journeys are multi-disciplinary, combining medical nutrition therapy with
professional coaching and psychological support to ensure that health goals—such as reversing
metabolic syndrome or optimizing longevity—are not only achieved but maintained. The team, composed
of experts and certified dietitians, emphasizes that health is interconnected; they address the
systemic links between sleep, hormones, hunger, and mood to provide a truly holistic roadmap for
wellbeing.

Ultimately, Global Precision Wellness serves as a bridge, transforming complex clinical data into
actionable, daily habits. By leveraging evidence-based practices and professional expertise, they
have cultivated a model where health is treated as a dynamic asset. Whether through individual
consultations or corporate partnerships, GPW’s mission is to provide the structure and
accountability necessary for people to take control of their health, fostering a culture of
excellence and longevity in both personal and professional life.

When there is interest on the part of the buyer, he is connected with the seller, a WhatsApp chat is
opened with them so that the transaction can be made.

and what the final process is are decided between them.

You also have the option, especially for first operations, to designate Resellers Connector as an
intermediary to receive the product and the money and once received and verify that everything is
okay, send what was agreed to each party and close the operation. This has a small additional cost.

1

* We can provide you with a specialized contract for resellers to have a better legal protection.

## We offer you more sales and more contacts!

1 Centralized Stock:
* All the stock of all our resellers in one place.
* +8000 Birkins and Kellys available for you.
2 Connecting Sellers and Buyers:
* Direct connections between buyer and seller on each deal.
* We don’t add profit margins or take sales commissions.
[Previous Slide] [Next Slide]

## YOU WILL INCREASE YOUR BUSINESS BY 30%, 50% OR 100% WITH US!

We give you more purchasing capacity!
We give you more sales capacity!

Could you do it without us?

Yes, but you would invest a lot of time, effort and money.
We have a team of 50 people!

Why so many people?
1. To increase the stock and contacts that we offer you daily
2. To centralize ALL STOCK and update it DAILY so that when you need something you can find it in a
   few clicks!

[Previous Slide] [Next Slide]

## The Service. The Connection.

When there is interest on the part of the buyer, he is connected with the seller, a WhatsApp chat is
opened with them so that the transaction can be made.

There, the final price, the payment method, the shipping method, and who takes care of each thing
and what the final process is are decided between them.

You also have the option, especially for first operations, to designate Resellers Connector as an
intermediary to receive the product and the money and once received and verify that everything is
okay, send what was agreed to each party and close the operation. This has a small additional cost.

## Our tools
1. A private WhatsApp chat with us for requests, to send your stock and to help you.
2. A WhatsApp community to stay informed of arrivals.
3. A search engine on the web to find what you need.

### Active Security

1 Verified Sellers:
* We rigorously verify all sellers to ensure the safety and integrity of our community.
2 Ongoing Monitoring:
* We actively monitor reseller behavior. Resellers who fail to act professionally will be removed
  from the platform. We will inform all our resellers and contacts about their conduct to prevent
  further business interactions with them trying to block their business if they don’t fix their
  mistakes.

## Security and Protection

### Reactive Security

1
* We can act like an escrow service.
2
* We can provide you with a specialized contract for resellers to have a better legal protection.

## What happens if a reseller sends a bag in other conditions?
1. Resellers Connector opens a group chat for each operation and remains in the chat in case it is
   necessary to mediate in case of conflict so that the transaction is successful for both parties.
2. Remember that it is an agreement between buyer and seller and the rules are agreed upon when the
   transaction is being made. And the status of the bag etc. is negotiated in that chat.
3. The normal thing is that, since we are all professionals, the bag and the agreed money are
   returned.
4. In the event that a reseller fails to comply with what was previously established, they will be
   expelled from the community and all resellers within the platform will be informed to ban them so
   that no one else makes transactions with them.
5. The risk of loss of business is significant enough for them to reconsider their actions.

## Is it safe to operate on the platform?

To be able to enter the community, resellers have to be verified.

However, we have 4 options to verify a reseller.

Ask us if you are interested.

demanding projects. Combining advanced engineering, precise manufacturing, and strict quality
control, we ensure every solution delivers exceptional performance, reliability, and durability for
applications in telecom, aerospace, and defense.

connectors and assemblies. With deep expertise in precision engineering and material science, we
deliver tailored solutions that overcome complex technical challenges where standard components fall
short, ensuring optimal performance and reliability across demanding RF and microwave applications.
[R]
Benefit from our streamlined manufacturing processes and extensive inventory that enable fast
turnaround and consistent supply. By integrating precision production with strict quality control,
we deliver reliable, high-performance products at competitive prices — giving you the flexibility,
efficiency, and value needed to stay ahead in today’s rapidly evolving RF industry.

One system. Total clinical freedom. 



Long-term satisfaction for patients around the world.



ROOTT® is not just an implant company — it is a complete, intelligently engineered ecosystem
designed to support clinicians in every indication, every workflow, and every level of complexity.



From immediate loading to complex cases, from simplicity to advanced solutions, ROOTT® empowers
clinicians with confidence, consistency, and control. 



We strongly believe that everyone deserves access to world-class implants that restore health and
confidence. 

Through high scale, lean operations and fundamental education, we make implants more accessible and
affordable.

A unified implant concept covering conventional, basal, pterygoid and compressive solutions.

### 98% Proven Clinical Success

Backed by long-term clinical data and real-world outcomes, ROOTT® delivers predictable, reproducible
results you can rely on.

### Trusted in 80+ Countries Worldwide

centers.



### Reliable Quality. Uninterrupted Supply.

consistency you can trust — case after case. 

### Smart Choice. High Performance. Highly Affordable.

Premium clinical performance without premium barriers — designed to support growth, not limit it.

Every design decision is made with one goal in mind: to simplify clinical work while expanding
treatment possibilities.

Our agile, R&D-driven approach allows ROOTT® to evolve continuously — responding quickly to
clinician feedback, clinical challenges, and real-world demands.

predictable **one-piece implant** solution capable of achieving high primary stability
for **immediate loading** across both the upper and lower jaws. This component must
offer **prosthetic flexibility** to manage divergence without compromising stability or requiring
complex multi-component restorations.

***Efficiency, Versatility, and FILO Integration***

[Learn more][70]

## ROOTT B/BS – Engineered to Bypass the Mandibular Nerve and Anchor in Dense Cortical Ridges.


ROOTT BASAL implants are specialized, one-piece implants designed specifically for **resorbed
ridges** and **immediate loading**. Their unique structural characteristics allow for predictable
placement in **height and width deficient bones** , offering an immediate solution for multiple unit
restorations across the upper and lower jaws. 




[Learn more][71]

## Casting Process

Casting is a fundamental process in the global manufacturing industry, and composite silica sol
casting, precoated sand shell casting, and sand casting are three of the most widely used
technologies among them. Through different mold materials and forming logics, they cover the full
range of needs from high-precision complex parts to large-scale general-purpose parts, serving
global core industries such as automotive, aerospace, energy, and medical care. Choosing the
appropriate process can significantly improve casting quality and reduce production costs.

## WhyChoose Us

We integrate three core casting technologies: sodium silicate sand casting, silica sol precision
casting, and precoated sand shell casting. Covering a full range of materials—including carbon
steel, low-alloy steel, high-manganese steel, stainless steel, and ductile iron (ADI included)—we
efficiently meet the demands for multi-variety, small-batch, and high-complexity components across
commercial vehicles, construction machinery, marine, and valve industries.

Equipped with 10+ induction furnaces, German Spectro spectrometers, and digital testing equipment,
we deliver top-tier precision components globally, such as commercial vehicle transmission parts,
pressure-resistant castings for construction machinery, valve fittings, and precision components for
special equipment.

## Industries We Serve

#### Telecommunications

Fiber and RF connectors for carrier networks, FTTH deployments, and 5G infrastructure.

#### Data Centers

High-density MPO/MTP assemblies and structured cabling solutions for hyperscale facilities.

#### Automotive

IATF 16949 certified connectors for EV charging, ADAS sensors, and vehicle wiring harnesses.

#### Aerospace & Defense

MIL-STD-810 qualified connectors for avionics, radar systems, and field communications.

[View All Industries][15]

## Why TE Connectivity

#### 100% In-Line Testing

Every connector undergoes interferometric endface inspection, insertion loss testing, and return
loss verification before shipping.

#### 24-Hour Shipping

95% of standard SKUs ship within 24 hours from 5 regional warehouses strategically positioned near
major deployment corridors.

#### Custom Engineering

In-house design team delivering 80+ custom connector projects annually with prototype samples in
5-10 business days.

## Recent Project Highlights

#### FTTH Deployment — Southeast Asian Carrier

A Tier 1 carrier in Southeast Asia required 2.4 million LC/SC fiber connectors for a national FTTH
rollout covering 800,000 premises across 14 provinces. We delivered all connectors over 18 months
with insertion loss averaging 0.11 dB (specification: ≤ 0.15 dB) and a field failure rate of 12 PPM
— 76% below the contractual ceiling of 50 PPM.

#### 5G Macro Cell Rollout — European Network Operator

A European mobile operator deploying 12,000 5G macro cells across three countries sourced PIM-rated
4.3-10 and N-type RF connectors from our facility. All connectors met PIM performance of ≤ -160 dBc
at 2 × 20W, verified through 100% factory PIM testing. The 18-month deployment completed 6 weeks
ahead of the contracted timeline.

#### Data Center Migration — North American Hyperscaler

A hyperscale data center operator migrating 4 facilities from 100G to 400G architecture required
45,000 MPO-12 and MPO-24 trunk assemblies with ≤ 0.35 dB total channel insertion loss. We completed
the order in 14 weeks, maintaining endface geometry compliance (IEC 61300-3-35 Grade A) across 100%
of delivered assemblies.

## Need a Custom Connector Solution?

From prototype quantities to volume production. Typical quotation turnaround: 48 hours.

# [Pogo Pin Connectors][143]

Pogo Pin connectors, also known as spring-loaded pins, are specialized connectors designed to
provide a reliable and flexible electrical connection. These connectors feature a spring-loaded
mechanism that ensures consistent contact pressure, making them ideal for applications requiring
precise, repeatable connections. Pogo Pins are widely used in a variety of electronic devices,
including mobile phones, wearables, medical devices, and testing equipment, where high-performance
and compact designs are essential.
[ VIEW MORE ][144]
[ [主图] ][145]

# [Pin Header&Female Header Connctors][146]

Pin header connectors are widely used in electronics, electrical appliances, and instrumentation PCB
circuit boards. Their main role is to connect and bridge blocked or isolated circuits within the
circuit, thereby undertaking the task of current or signal transmission. They are usually used in
conjunction with a socket to form a board-to-board connection, with electronic harness terminals for
board-to-wire connections, and can also be used independently for board-to-board connections.

# [Pogo Pin Connectors][143]

Pogo Pin connectors, also known as spring-loaded pins, are specialized connectors designed to
provide a reliable and flexible electrical connection. These connectors feature a spring-loaded
mechanism that ensures consistent contact pressure, making them ideal for applications requiring
precise, repeatable connections. Pogo Pins are widely used in a variety of electronic devices,
including mobile phones, wearables, medical devices, and testing equipment, where high-performance
and compact designs are essential.
[ VIEW MORE ][144]
[ [主图] ][145]

# [Pin Header&Female Header Connctors][146]

Pin header connectors are widely used in electronics, electrical appliances, and instrumentation PCB
circuit boards. Their main role is to connect and bridge blocked or isolated circuits within the
circuit, thereby undertaking the task of current or signal transmission. They are usually used in
conjunction with a socket to form a board-to-board connection, with electronic harness terminals for
board-to-wire connections, and can also be used independently for board-to-board connections.

ABOUT US

Ningbo Zhongling Precision Manufacturing Co., Ltd. was established in November 2021 and is a modern
manufacturing enterprise specializing in the field of metal precision machining. The factory is
located in Dacheng Street, Beilun District, Ningbo City, Zhejiang Province. This area is an
important gathering place for high-end equipment manufacturing industry in Ningbo, with mature
supporting industrial chains and convenient transportation and logistics. The company has a
standardized sheet metal workshop of 2300 square meters and a precision stamping mold workshop of
3500 square meters. It has independently planned production and processing areas, quality inspection
and testing areas, storage areas, packaging areas, and office areas, with a scientifically
reasonable layout to meet the needs of large-scale production. At present, the company has core
departments such as production, quality inspection, technology, and business. There are more than 40
employees, with 30% having a bachelor's degree. The team members have many years of experience in
the metal precision manufacturing industry, providing solid support for product quality and
technological innovation.

ABOUT US

Ningbo Zhongling Precision Manufacturing Co., Ltd. was established in November 2021 and is a modern
manufacturing enterprise specializing in the field of metal precision machining. The factory is
located in Dacheng Street, Beilun District, Ningbo City, Zhejiang Province. This area is an
important gathering place for high-end equipment manufacturing industry in Ningbo, with mature
supporting industrial chains and convenient transportation and logistics. The company has a
standardized sheet metal workshop of 2300 square meters and a precision stamping mold workshop of
3500 square meters. It has independently planned production and processing areas, quality inspection
and testing areas, storage areas, packaging areas, and office areas, with a scientifically
reasonable layout to meet the needs of large-scale production. At present, the company has core
departments such as production, quality inspection, technology, and business. There are more than 40
employees, with 30% having a bachelor's degree. The team members have many years of experience in
the metal precision manufacturing industry, providing solid support for product quality and
technological innovation.
